I've had fairly rubbish experiences with NHS reception staff in the past but let's be honest it's a thankless unending task every day. Too many patients for not enough GP's.
I've never experienced anyone being rude or short with me here, the phone lines can take a while but that's about the only negative. Front end staff have been fine, they do the best for you with what resources are available. When you do get to see the GP, they are fantastic.

I genuinely think this place deserves five stars although it's unfortunately oversubscribed in my opinion which can obviously result in frustration with the timescales they provide at The receptionist, Aura, was shockingly rude, dismissive, and showed no empathy during the call. My partner, who was already anxious due to recent medical issues, became so upset that she broke down in tears and had to hand the phone to me.

Overhearing the call, I was appalled by Aura's tone and lack of professionalism, especially when dealing with sensitive medical concerns. This was a stark contrast to the excellent care both my partner and I have previously received from the practice.

It’s incredibly disappointing that the reception staff do not reflect the same high standard of care.
